### Considering Others Better Than Yourself
Author: Amanda Idleman
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/crosswalk-devo/considering-others-better-than-yourself-the-crosswalk-devotion.html
Passage: Philippians 2:3
Points:
- Selfish ambition is humanity's natural default, but Christians are called to actively choose humility.
- True humility is not self-hatred or martyrdom, but having an accurate, modest view of personal importance.
- Using spiritual gifts and freedom to serve others shifts our focus away from self-obsession.
- Immersing ourselves in Scripture reminds us of human limitations and reorients life around loving God and neighbor.
- Living with reverent awe before God produces a quiet, obedient, and service-centered heart.

### Christian Humility
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/christian-humility
Passage: Philippians 2:3-4
Points:
- Achieving genuine unity within the church requires intentionally rejecting personal rivalry and empty conceit.
- Ministry among believers must be driven by love for God's people rather than personal promotion.
- Counting others as more significant does not erase personal dignity, but prioritizes their well-being before our own.
- Biblical humility manifests as an outward, other-centered posture modeled after Christ's servant heart.
- Assuming the best about fellow believers enables us to joyfully surrender our rights to serve them.
